intro: Items marked NEW were added or changed in this version — please test those first. CRITICAL means: if it fails, the version must not ship.

items.text: Plugin installs from the repository without an error
Updating from the previous version keeps settings and database
No "Echokraut is creating errors" popup from Dalamud after startup
Both /echokraut and /ek open the window
Changelog popup appears after the update and lists this version's entries
Window title shows the correct version number
AllTalk backend: connection is detected and voices are loaded
EchokrauTTS backend: connection is detected and voices are loaded
Switching backends at runtime works without restarting the game
Backend down or unreachable: a clear message instead of a crash or a freeze
Streaming generation: playback starts before the clip has finished generating
items.hint: Not only at the very end — audio should audibly start well before generation completes.

items.text: Streaming playback does not flood dalamud.log
items.hint: Play a few streamed lines, then search dalamud.log for "Stream underrun": a handful of lines is fine, hundreds of identical lines with the same timestamp are not. Watch for stutter while a line plays.

items.text: A fresh install of AllTalk / EchokrauTTS completes successfully
"Check for updates" correctly reports either an available update or up-to-date
"Update" installs the zip from the same release as the reported tag
A failed check returns the button to "Check for updates" (it does not claim you are up to date)
After the update finished, the button reads "Check for updates" again
items.hint: It must not still say "Update" — clicking it a second time must not reinstall the same release.

items.text: A greyed-out "Update" (after a check that found nothing) does nothing when clicked
Updating the wrapper leaves voices and models untouched
NPC dialogue windows are read out
Speech bubbles are read out
Battle talk and cutscene lines are read out
Chat messages are read out according to the configured settings
Dismissing a dialogue stops playback immediately
Clicking rapidly through dialogue never overlaps or leaves playback stuck
Lines already voiced by the game are not spoken a second time
The volume slider takes effect immediately
The voice comes from the NPC's direction — turning the camera audibly moves it
items.hint: Test this with the camera TILTED as well, not just level: the old reading was only correct while the camera was horizontal.

items.text: Distance matters: farther away is quieter
The audible range setting survives a restart
items.hint: Set the range, restart the game, and compare how far away a voice is still audible — without touching the slider again. It used to fall back to the engine default on every start.

items.text: A moving speaker does not change the voice's pitch
items.hint: Move the slider once, then listen to a walking NPC or move yourself while a line plays: the voice must not warble or detune.

items.text: With 3D audio disabled, playback is clean and centred
New NPCs automatically get a fitting voice (gender / race)
A manually assigned voice survives a restart
Previewing a voice in the voice selection works
The voice pack downloads and its 260 voices show up in the selection
items.hint: Game Data Tools -> Voice Pack, or a fresh engine install. Expect 100 male and 100 female adult voices plus 30 male and 30 female child voices.

items.text: A fresh local AllTalk / EchokrauTTS install seeds its voices from the pack automatically
items.hint: Install an engine from scratch. The setup wizard should show download progress and the engine's voice folder should end up holding the pack's voices.

items.text: Manual download from Game Data Tools lands in the right folder
items.hint: It targets the active engine's voice folder when the engine runs locally, otherwise your local save location. Careful: for a locally installed engine that folder is REPLACED, so put your own voices somewhere else before testing.

items.text: Downloading the pack over an existing one really replaces the child voices
items.hint: The child voices changed in this version but kept their filenames. After a second download the '-Child' voices must sound English and child-like, not Icelandic. If they still sound like the old ones, the files were not overwritten.

items.text: Child NPCs get one of the child voices, not an adult one
items.hint: Talk to an obviously young NPC. The pack ships 30 male and 30 female child voices (their filenames contain '-Child'); auto-assignment should pick from those.

items.text: Generated child speech is intelligible and actually sounds like a child
items.hint: Let a child NPC speak a few longer lines. Expect a child-like timbre with an English accent. Listen for the failure modes of the pitch shift: a metallic or watery ring, breathy artefacts, or a voice that just sounds like a sped-up adult.

items.text: Male NPCs get male pack voices and female NPCs female ones
items.hint: Gender and race are read out of the voice filename. If everyone ends up with the same voice, or gender is ignored, the filenames were not parsed.

items.text: A configured custom voices URL still wins: the pack download is skipped
items.hint: With a custom voices URL set, installing an engine must not pull the pack over your own voices.

items.text: LICENSE.txt and ATTRIBUTION.csv end up in the voice folder
items.hint: Both ship inside the pack and must be present after the download - they carry the CC BY 4.0 attribution for every voice.

items.text: Phonetic corrections are applied to pronunciation
A muted dialogue stays silent
Every tab opens without freezing or crashing the game
Long lists page cleanly (page numbers, arrows, no crash while paging)
Voice Clip Manager: play, regenerate and delete all work
Log tab keeps showing new entries and the filters take effect
The window cannot be dragged fully off screen
Language switching (EN/DE/FR/JA): no empty or truncated labels
Greyed-out controls do nothing when clicked (buttons, checkboxes, sliders, dropdowns)
items.hint: In "Audio files only" mode the dimmed generate buttons and the dimmed chat/voice options must not react at all.

items.text: Settings -> Backend: the SELECTED mode is the greyed-out one, the other two are clickable and switch modes
items.hint: Same in the setup wizard for AllTalk / EchokrauTTS. You must never end up unable to switch back.

items.text: An existing echokraut.db migrates without data loss
A fresh install creates the database without errors
Settings, voices and phonetics survive a game restart
No noticeable FPS drops while playback is running
30+ minutes of play with no crash, no freeze and no steadily growing memory use
Zone changes and cutscenes abort playback cleanly
Disabling or reloading the plugin leaves no errors in the Dalamud log
The wrapper starts and reports itself as ready
The GPU is used (generation is faster than real time)
/tts delivers audio progressively (chunked), not only at the end
The voice list is served to the plugin correctly
Restarting the wrapper is noticed by the plugin and playback works again afterwards
